name: cat-crane-game
description: Android app wrapper for Oinotch Crane Cat Challenge.

scripts.sync:android: npm run prepare:web && cap sync android
scripts.build:android:debug: npm run sync:android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.build:android:bundle: npm run sync:android && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
scripts.open:android: npm run sync:android && cap open android
